crop.notes: Sporting Notes column; only the first item is about Allen. The others concern a postponed Browns ball game and billiardist Lew Shaw.

title.suggested: Tom Allen's Market Street concert saloon advertised

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat's Sporting Notes carried a notice for Tom Allen, retired champion pugilist of the world, at 619 Market Street, offering a free concert every evening with only the best singers.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, March 19, 1892, page 7. Same notice as article 842.

facts.fact: Allen's saloon at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, advertised a free concert every evening

notes: The current title and summary say he announced his retirement; the item is an advertising notice that calls him the retired champion.
